title_en: A young hero shoes his horse
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, origin unclear. 'Лудо' in folk songs is a tender word for a young lover, so I rendered it 'my dear'.

words_to_learn.en: I will turn into, I will become

lines.en: A young hero, dear, is shoeing his horse,

lines.cyr: мома му вели, мома му вели.
lines.lat: moma mu veli, moma mu veli.
lines.en: the girl speaks to him, the girl speaks to him.

lines.cyr: Ем му вели, џанам, ем го моли:
lines.lat: Em mu veli, džanam, em go moli:
lines.en: She speaks to him, dear, and begs him:

lines.cyr: - Земај ти мене, земај и мене.
lines.lat: - Zemaj ti mene, zemaj i mene.

lines.cyr: на твој вилает, на твој вилает.
lines.lat: na tvoj vilaet, na tvoj vilaet.
lines.en: to your homeland, to your homeland.
- My homeland, girl, is far away,

lines.cyr: не мож' да дојдеш, не мож' да дојдеш.
lines.lat: ne mož' da dojdeš, ne mož' da dojdeš.
lines.en: you cannot come, you cannot come.

lines.cyr: Пред нас има моме Црно Море,
lines.lat: Pred nas ima mome Crno More,
lines.en: Before us lies the Black Sea, girl,

lines.cyr: не мож' да пројдеш, не мож' да пројдеш.
lines.lat: ne mož' da projdeš, ne mož' da projdeš.
lines.en: you cannot cross, you cannot cross.

lines.cyr: - Ќе се сторам, лудо, морска риба,
lines.lat: - Ḱe se storam, ludo, morska riba,
lines.en: - I will turn into a sea fish, my dear,

lines.cyr: со теб' ќе дојдам, со теб' ќе дојдам.
lines.lat: so teb' ḱe dojdam, so teb' ḱe dojdam.
lines.en: I will come with you, I will come with you.

lines.cyr: - Пред нас има моме густа гора,
lines.lat: - Pred nas ima mome gusta gora,
lines.en: - Before us lies a thick forest, girl,

lines.cyr: не мож' да пројдеш, не мож' да пројдеш.
lines.lat: ne mož' da projdeš, ne mož' da projdeš.
lines.en: you cannot pass, you cannot pass.

lines.cyr: - Ќе се сторам, лудо, остра сабја,
lines.lat: - Ḱe se storam, ludo, ostra sabja,
lines.en: - I will turn into a sharp sabre, my dear,

lines.cyr: гора ќе сечам, гора ќе сечам.
lines.lat: gora ḱe sečam, gora ḱe sečam.
lines.en: I will cut the forest, I will cut the forest.
